name: ARTRONIQ
recent: Artroniq 于2026年10月9日签署协议，以RM5.15百万收购Hutchinson Asset Management Series B 75%股权，并于11月8日完成，使其成为全资子公司。公司同时推进最多51,142,000股新股（占10%）的私募配售，Bursa Securities已于9月14日批准上市。此外，公司自10月起持续在公开市场回购股份。
notable: 签署协议以RM5.15百万收购Hutchinson Asset Management Series B 75%股权，并于2026年11月8日完成。
拟私募配售最多51,142,000股新股（占已发行股份10%），Bursa Securities于2026年9月14日批准上市。
自2026年10月起多次在公开市场回购股份。
risks: 私募配售最多10%新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
董事在闭门期前表示有意交易公司股份。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为RM5.399百万，环比增长142.8%，同比增长69.7%；净利润为RM34,000，净利率0.6%，较上一季度的-49.0%转正。

recent_en: Artroniq signed an agreement on 9 October 2026 to acquire 75% of Hutchinson Asset Management Series B for RM5.15 million, completing the deal on 8 November 2026 and making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The company is also proceeding with a private placement of up to 51,142,000 new shares (10% of issued shares), approved for listing by Bursa Securities on 14 September. In addition, the company has been continuously buying back shares in the open market since October.
notable_en: Signed an agreement to acquire 75% of Hutchinson Asset Management Series B for RM5.15 million, completed on 8 November 2026.
Proposed private placement of up to 51,142,000 new shares (10% of issued shares), with listing approved by Bursa Securities on 14 September 2026.
Multiple share buybacks in the open market since October 2026.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Directors indicated intention to deal in company shares ahead of the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM5.399 million, up 142.8% QoQ and 69.7% YoY; net income was RM34,000 with a net margin of 0.6%, turning positive from -49.0% in the previous quarter.
